**Why promote rather than hold**: same file, same criterion, and same fix session as #3755 (just queued this round) — both are declared-but-unreachable artifacts in the create-plugin scaffold output, and both bodies name direction 2 (delete) as the clean default with direction 1 as the argued alternative. Holding this one while #3755 dispatches would guarantee a second `templates.ts` pass later for a fix the same dev can make in the same PR.

**Dispatch note**: natural PR-mate of #3755 — one dev should take both together (the bodies already require serializing with #3742/PR #3754 on the same file). The dead-artifact vs export-the-contract choice is arguable in the PR; a maintainer veto there is cheap.
